decisions.reason: It is close to the firm's established secure-communications software knowledge and survived the first portfolio shake-out, but its limited website prominence suggests a moderate risk of being folded into other offerings or discontinued.

A multi-layer end-to-end security architecture sits squarely in the firm's core cybersecurity competence, and the dedicated 2019 page indicates enough strategic importance and learning potential to justify continued development.

Although related to the firm's digital-signature business, the hardware-token element is less aligned with a medium-sized software consultancy's strongest knowledge base, making it harder to absorb feedback and improve profitably than pure software products.
A payment-network security compliance suite builds on the firm's existing software, security, and advisory capabilities, so the firm is well placed to refine it even if it remains a niche offering.
